title: Annotatio V §.V: Vain charity with wounded Truth; empty Truth without charity — no confessor who splits Union
pass_a_gloss: Vain is Charity with injury to Truth; empty is Truth without the exercise of Charity. No one will show true charity without solid profession of Truth; nor will anyone hear a faithful Confessor of saving doctrine who, charity having been broken, splits the Union.
pass_b_english: Charity with injury to Truth is vain; Truth without the exercise of Charity is empty.
No one shows true charity without a solid profession of Truth.
Nor is anyone heard as a faithful confessor of saving doctrine who, having broken Charity, splits the Union.
source_text: Vana Charitas est cum laesione Veritatis, inanis Veritas absque exercitio Charitatis. Nemo aperiet veram charitatem sine professione solidâ Veritatis; neque quisquam audiet Confessor fidelis salutaris doctrinae, qui ruptâ Charitate scindit Unionem.
notes: Vana/inanis pair; confessor who splits Union.
